city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom on Staten Island: New York birth support and doula care with the Verrazzano Bridge skyline in the background
city_fields.culture: Staten Island is New York City's southernmost and most suburban borough, home to roughly 476,000 residents across neighborhoods like Tompkinsville, Great Kills, and Tottenville. Its birth culture reflects a close-knit, family-centered community that is more suburban than most of the city, with many families delivering at Staten Island University Hospital or Richmond University Medical Center. The borough has a growing, dedicated doula community, and New York State Medicaid has expanded doula coverage, helping make doula support more accessible to Staten Island families.
